objective.goal: Find model architectures (with training settings that suit them) that best predict DeepSTARR enhancer activity (developmental and housekeeping) in Drosophila S2 cells from 249 bp sequence, trained on a random half of the published DeepSTARR training set; explore new architecture types widely.
objective.intended_use: A better STARR-seq oracle: a stronger sequence-to-activity model for Drosophila S2 enhancers.
in_scope: structure: agents may rewrite the structure blocks

out_of_scope.item: No ensembles inside a model: a candidate is one network, not an average of several independently built or trained sub-networks. Ensembles are made after the search.

objective.stopped_because: The run's budget was used up: 200 evaluations allowed, 201 training runs ended, some of them not charged in full.
objective.intended_scale: Any size: larger models are fine if they fit an 11 GB GPU and the 2-hour timeout.

data.name: DeepSTARR UMI-STARR-seq, Drosophila S2 (de Almeida et al. 2022, Zenodo 7265991), half of training
data.output: enhancer activity, log2, for the developmental (Dev) and housekeeping (Hk) promoter
data.splits: published train, valid and test sets of DeepSTARR_data.h5; train = random 50% (numpy seed 0) of the 201,139 training sequences, each with its reverse complement as in the published set

evaluation.test_policy: Test metrics come from the run's hidden diagnostics, which evoloop stores and never shows to an agent or uses to choose between models.
evaluation.noise_floor_method: an estimate from one run of the baseline: how much its score moved between its last progress reports. It leaves out what differs between two runs, so it tends to read low

inference_hardware.passes: one forward pass per sequence, eval mode, fastest of 2 to 6 timed passes
inference_hardware.measured_by: Claude, in a cloud sandbox, for this example. Not measured by the depositor.

search.method: evoloop, profile harness: language-model agents propose new model structures and edits of settings, and code schedules, trains and scores every candidate; each generation is divided by kind of move (style set by move_shares). Roles in use: explorer, exploiter, analyst.

notes.text: Each lineage of the search had its own range for a setting. training_space gives the widest range over the lineages.

findings.statement: A train-only random per-sample input shift of ±3 bp lowers validation MSE on every backbone it has been added to. Gains: BiGRU +1.08 (C40), gMLP +0.89/+1.11 (C48, C54), aMLP +1.12 (C55), gated WaveNet +0.54/+0.41/+0.24 (C46, C78, C88), S4D-gated gMLP +0.6 (C51), S4D +0.8 (C58), U-Net +0.84 (C59), dynamic conv +0.75 (C65). It moves the best epoch later. Widening it to ±8 bp gave nothing more (C45).

open_questions: The leader C172 rises from 1.094 at epoch 37 to about 1.10-1.11 after its peak, with train MSE 0.80. Does a much stronger AdamW weight decay (0.1) lower its minimum?
Does train-only Gaussian input noise (sigma 0.15) lower plain bidirectional S4D? Both earlier attempts timed out on 60-epoch schedules (C163, C176), so the test must fit the time limit.
How much of C172's lead comes from the Gaussian input noise? The 62-token stem moved onto the fp32 line gave nothing (C186, -0.28), and neither did the attention pool (C180).

Dilated depthwise convs matched BiS4D in the plain S4 block at half the cost (C165), and many mixers converge at 1.12-1.14 on the leader's stem. Do they also match BiS4D as the token mixer inside the leader's spatial gating unit?
The multires wavelet mixer was at 1.124 and still falling when it timed out at epoch 34 (C178, about 210 s/epoch). If it fits the time limit, does it reach the top cluster?
Is the leader's mid-schedule instability, and the collapses of edits on its base (C184, C185), caused by fp16 amp? Does C172 in fp32 train more stably and score at least as well?

models.name: convstem_transformer
models.hypothesis: Enhancer activity depends on combinations and spacing of TF motifs across the 249 bp. A conv stem detects motifs, and self-attention over the 62 resulting tokens models their pairwise interactions with fewer parameters and better generalisation than flatten+dense. With a warm-up/annealing schedule, AdamW and reverse-complement averaging, it should match or beat the untuned baseline.
models.predicted_effect: Validation score of about 1.34 (range 1.30-1.42), best epoch between 20 and 35 of 40. Hk should gain more than Dev, since Hk activity depends more on motif combinations.
models.change_summary: New hybrid backbone: conv stem to 62 tokens, learned positional embedding, 4 pre-norm transformer layers (d=192, 8 heads), attention+mean pooling head. train_params changed to AdamW lr 1e-3, wd 0.05, onecycle over 40 epochs, grad_clip 1.0, amp on, rc_average on, because transformers need warm-up and clipping.

models.code:
class ConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c_in, c_out, k, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, k, padding="same")
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(c_out)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.res = (c_in == c_out)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.drop(F.gelu(self.bn(self.conv(x))))
        return x + y if self.res else y


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, d=192, n_layers=4, n_heads=8, ff=384, attn_dropout=0.1, head_dropout=0.3,
                 n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            ConvBlock(4, 128, 11, 0.1),
            ConvBlock(128, 128, 7, 0.1),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            ConvBlock(128, d, 5, 0.1),
            ConvBlock(d, d, 5, 0.1),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
        )
        n_tok = (length // 2) // 2
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, n_tok, d))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=d, nhead=n_heads, dim_feedforward=ff, dropout=attn_dropout,
                                           activation="gelu", batch_first=True, norm_first=True)
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(layer, num_layers=n_layers, enable_nested_tensor=False)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn_pool = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * d, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(head_dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, n_tasks),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)            # (N, T, d)
        h = self.encoder(h + self.pos)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn_pool(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)   # (N, T, 1)
        pooled = torch.cat([(w * h).sum(1), h.mean(1)], dim=-1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvTransformer()
    net.stem.apply(init_weights)
    net.attn_pool.apply(init_weights)
    net.head.apply(init_weights)
    return net

models.name: dilated-resnet-124
models.hypothesis: A stack of pre-activation dilated residual convolutions at near-full resolution can read motif grammar and long-range motif interactions across the whole 249 bp. With strand averaging, this should cut validation MSE, mainly for Dev, whose activity depends more on motif combinations.
models.predicted_effect: Validation score around 1.30 (about 1.5 noise floors better than C2), with the best epoch between 25 and 50 of 60. Dev MSE should improve more than Hk.
models.change_summary: New backbone: conv stem k15 then six dilated residual blocks (256 channels, dilations 1 to 32), then pool, 1x1 conv and flatten-dense head. Own train_params: AdamW with weight decay 0.01, lr 0.002, onecycle over 60 epochs, amp, grad_clip 1, rc_average. The deeper residual net needs a warm-up schedule, unlike the leader's constant-lr recipe.

models.name: deepstarr_dilated_res_mid
models.hypothesis: In C7 each residual block adds relu(bn(conv(x))) with BN gamma=1. At init this adds four unit-scale, all-positive feature maps to the 60-channel conv-2 output. That shifts the input statistics of conv blocks 3 and 4 and costs the baseline's working path, which is a plausible cause of C7 landing 0.4 floors behind C2. Zero-initialising the branch BN scale makes the network start exactly as C2's baseline. The dilated branches then grow only as far as they help, which should show the long-range context this stack covers (about the whole 62-step map) without the harm at init.
models.predicted_effect: Validation MSE falls to about C2's level or a little below, roughly 1.35-1.36, with similar epochs to the best result.
models.change_summary: Zero-init BatchNorm gamma in the dilated residual branches (identity at start)

models.code:
def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, (nn.Conv1d, nn.Linear)):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


class S4DKernel(nn.Module):
    """Diagonal state-space kernel (S4D-Lin init), returns (H, L) real kernel."""
    def __init__(self, H, N=64, dt_min=1e-3, dt_max=1e-1):
        super().__init__()
        log_dt = torch.rand(H) * (math.log(dt_max) - math.log(dt_min)) + math.log(dt_min)
        self.log_dt = nn.Parameter(log_dt)
        self.log_A_real = nn.Parameter(torch.log(0.5 * torch.ones(H, N // 2)))
        self.A_imag = nn.Parameter(math.pi * torch.arange(N // 2).float().repeat(H, 1))
        self.C = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H, N // 2, 2) * (0.5 ** 0.5))

    def forward(self, L):
        dt = torch.exp(self.log_dt)
        C = torch.view_as_complex(self.C.contiguous())
        A = -torch.exp(self.log_A_real) + 1j * self.A_imag
        dtA = A * dt[:, None]
        pos = torch.arange(L, device=dtA.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        Kexp = torch.exp(dtA[..., None] * pos)
        C = C * (torch.exp(dtA) - 1.0) / A
        K = 2 * torch.einsum('hn,hnl->hl', C, Kexp).real
        return K


class BiS4D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, H, N=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.H = H
        self.kernel = S4DKernel(2 * H, N)
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H))

    @staticmethod
    def fftconv(u, k):
        L = u.shape[-1]
        n = 2 * L
        U = torch.fft.rfft(u, n=n)
        Kf = torch.fft.rfft(k, n=n)
        return torch.fft.irfft(U * Kf, n=n)[..., :L]

    def forward(self, u):  # u: (B, H, L)
        u = u.float()
        L = u.shape[-1]
        k = self.kernel(L)
        kf, kb = k[:self.H], k[self.H:]
        y = self.fftconv(u, kf) + torch.flip(self.fftconv(torch.flip(u, dims=[-1]), kb), dims=[-1])
        return y + u * self.D[None, :, None]


class S4Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, H, N=64, dropout=0.1, ff_mult=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(H)
        self.s4 = BiS4D(H, N)
        self.out = nn.Linear(H, 2 * H)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(H)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H, ff_mult * H), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout), nn.Linear(ff_mult * H, H))

    def forward(self, x):  # x: (B, L, H)
        z = self.norm1(x).transpose(1, 2)
        z = self.s4(z).transpose(1, 2)
        z = F.glu(self.out(F.gelu(z)), dim=-1)
        x = x + self.drop(z)
        x = x + self.drop(self.ff(self.norm2(x)))
        return x


class S4DNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model=256, n_layers=6, N=64, dropout=0.1, head_dropout=0.2, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_model, 15, padding=7),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(d_model),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
        )
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([S4Block(d_model, N, dropout) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * d_model, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(head_dropout), nn.Linear(256, n_tasks)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)  # (B, 124, H)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean(dim=1), h.max(dim=1).values], dim=-1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = S4DNet()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


class SpatialGatingUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_ffn, n_tok):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_ffn // 2)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(n_tok, n_tok)

    def forward(self, x):                      # x: (N, T, d_ffn)
        u, v = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        v = self.norm(v)
        v = self.proj(v.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
        return u * v


class GMLPBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, d_ffn, n_tok, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(d, d_ffn)
        self.sgu = SpatialGatingUnit(d_ffn, n_tok)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(d_ffn // 2, d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = F.gelu(self.fc1(self.norm(x)))
        y = self.sgu(y)
        y = self.drop(self.fc2(y))
        return x + y


class ConvGMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, stem=128, d=192, d_ffn=768, n_layers=6, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, d, 5, padding=2), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 124 -> 62
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        n_tok = (length // 2) // 2
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[GMLPBlock(d, d_ffn, n_tok, 0.1) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)           # (N, T, d)
        h = self.blocks(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        att = (w * h).sum(dim=1)
        mean = h.mean(dim=1)
        mx = h.max(dim=1).values
        z = torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.head(z))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvGMLP()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    for m in net.modules():
        if isinstance(m, SpatialGatingUnit):
            nn.init.normal_(m.proj.weight, std=1e-3)
            nn.init.ones_(m.proj.bias)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


class CrossBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, n_heads, ff, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.nq = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.nkv = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(d, n_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout), nn.Linear(ff, d), nn.Dropout(dropout))

    def forward(self, z, h):
        kv = self.nkv(h)
        a, _ = self.attn(self.nq(z), kv, kv, need_weights=False)
        z = z + self.drop(a)
        z = z + self.ff(self.nf(z))
        return z


class PerceiverSeq(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, emb=128, d=192, n_latents=48, n_heads=8, ff=512, self_layers=3,
                 attn_dropout=0.1, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, emb, 7, padding=3), bn(emb), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(emb, d, 7, padding=3), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, length, d))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        self.latents = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, n_latents, d))
        nn.init.normal_(self.latents, std=0.02)
        self.cross1 = CrossBlock(d, n_heads, ff, attn_dropout)
        self.cross2 = CrossBlock(d, n_heads, ff, attn_dropout)
        l1 = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=d, nhead=n_heads, dim_feedforward=ff, dropout=attn_dropout,
                                        activation="gelu", batch_first=True, norm_first=True)
        l2 = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=d, nhead=n_heads, dim_feedforward=ff, dropout=attn_dropout,
                                        activation="gelu", batch_first=True, norm_first=True)
        self.self1 = nn.TransformerEncoder(l1, num_layers=self_layers, enable_nested_tensor=False)
        self.self2 = nn.TransformerEncoder(l2, num_layers=self_layers, enable_nested_tensor=False)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn_pool = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.embed(x).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos      # (N, L, d)
        z = self.latents.expand(h.shape[0], -1, -1)
        z = self.cross1(z, h)
        z = self.self1(z)
        z = self.cross2(z, h)
        z = self.self2(z)
        z = self.norm(z)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn_pool(z).float(), dim=1).to(z.dtype)
        pooled = torch.cat([(w * z).sum(1), z.mean(1), z.max(1).values], dim=-1)
        return self.out(self.head(pooled))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = PerceiverSeq()
    net.embed.apply(init_weights)
    net.attn_pool.apply(init_weights)
    net.head.apply(init_weights)
    net.out.apply(init_weights)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


class S4DKernel(nn.Module):
    """Diagonal state-space kernel (S4D-Lin init), returns (H, L) real kernel."""
    def __init__(self, H, N=64, dt_min=1e-3, dt_max=1e-1):
        super().__init__()
        log_dt = torch.rand(H) * (math.log(dt_max) - math.log(dt_min)) + math.log(dt_min)
        self.log_dt = nn.Parameter(log_dt)
        self.log_A_real = nn.Parameter(torch.log(0.5 * torch.ones(H, N // 2)))
        self.A_imag = nn.Parameter(math.pi * torch.arange(N // 2).float().repeat(H, 1))
        self.C = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H, N // 2, 2) * (0.5 ** 0.5))

    def forward(self, L):
        dt = torch.exp(self.log_dt.float())
        C = torch.view_as_complex(self.C.float().contiguous())
        A = -torch.exp(self.log_A_real.float()) + 1j * self.A_imag.float()
        dtA = A * dt[:, None]
        pos = torch.arange(L, device=dtA.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        Kexp = torch.exp(dtA[..., None] * pos)          # (H, N/2, L)
        C = C * (torch.exp(dtA) - 1.0) / A
        K = 2 * (C[..., None] * Kexp).sum(dim=1).real   # (H, L)
        return K


class BiS4D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, H, N=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.H = H
        self.kernel = S4DKernel(2 * H, N)
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H))

    @staticmethod
    def fftconv(u, k):
        L = u.shape[-1]
        n = 2 * L
        U = torch.fft.rfft(u, n=n)
        Kf = torch.fft.rfft(k, n=n)
        return torch.fft.irfft(U * Kf, n=n)[..., :L]

    def forward(self, u):  # u: (B, H, L)
        u = u.float()
        L = u.shape[-1]
        k = self.kernel(L)
        kf, kb = k[:self.H], k[self.H:]
        y = self.fftconv(u, kf) + torch.flip(self.fftconv(torch.flip(u, dims=[-1]), kb), dims=[-1])
        return y + u * self.D.float()[None, :, None]


class SpatialGatingUnit(nn.Module):
    """gMLP gate whose token mixing is a bidirectional S4D long convolution."""
    def __init__(self, d_ffn, n_tok, state=64):
        super().__init__()
        h = d_ffn // 2
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(h)
        self.s4 = BiS4D(h, state)
        self.gate_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(h))

    def forward(self, x):                      # x: (N, T, d_ffn)
        u, v = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        v = self.norm(v)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
            g = self.s4(v.float().transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
            g = g + self.gate_bias.float()
        return u * g.to(u.dtype)


class GMLPBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, d_ffn, n_tok, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(d, d_ffn)
        self.sgu = SpatialGatingUnit(d_ffn, n_tok)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(d_ffn // 2, d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = F.gelu(self.fc1(self.norm(x)))
        y = self.sgu(y)
        y = self.drop(self.fc2(y))
        return x + y


class ConvGMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, stem=128, d=192, d_ffn=768, n_layers=6, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, d, 5, padding=2), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 124 -> 62
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        n_tok = (length // 2) // 2
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[GMLPBlock(d, d_ffn, n_tok, 0.1) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)           # (N, T, d)
        h = self.blocks(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        att = (w * h).sum(dim=1)
        mean = h.mean(dim=1)
        mx = h.max(dim=1).values
        z = torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.head(z))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvGMLP()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    return net

class ConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c_in, c_out, k, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, k, padding="same")
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(c_out)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.res = (c_in == c_out)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.drop(F.gelu(self.bn(self.conv(x))))
        return x + y if self.res else y


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, d=192, n_layers=4, n_heads=8, ff=384, attn_dropout=0.2, head_dropout=0.3,
                 n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            ConvBlock(4, 128, 11, 0.1),

    def __init__(self, c_in, c_out, k, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, k, padding="same")
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(c_out)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.res = (c_in == c_out)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.drop(F.gelu(self.bn(self.conv(x))))
        return x + y if self.res else y


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, d=192, n_layers=4, n_heads=8, ff=384, attn_dropout=0.1, head_dropout=0.3,
                 n_tasks=2, pos_kernel=7):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            ConvBlock(4, 128, 11, 0.1),
            ConvBlock(128, 128, 7, 0.1),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            ConvBlock(128, d, 5, 0.1),
            ConvBlock(d, d, 5, 0.1),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
        )
        # conditional (relative) positional encoding: residual depthwise conv, translation-equivariant
        self.pos_conv = nn.Conv1d(d, d, pos_kernel, padding=pos_kernel // 2, groups=d)
        layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=d, nhead=n_heads, dim_feedforward=ff, dropout=attn_dropout,
                                           activation="gelu", batch_first=True, norm_first=True)
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(layer, num_layers=n_layers, enable_nested_tensor=False)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn_pool = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * d, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(head_dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, n_tasks),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x)                            # (N, d, T)
        h = h + self.pos_conv(h)
        h = h.transpose(1, 2)                       # (N, T, d)
        h = self.encoder(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn_pool(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)   # (N, T, 1)
        pooled = torch.cat([(w * h).sum(1), h.mean(1)], dim=-1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvTransformer()
    net.stem.apply(init_weights)
    net.attn_pool.apply(init_weights)

class ConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c_in, c_out, k, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, k, padding="same")
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(c_out)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.res = (c_in == c_out)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.drop(F.gelu(self.bn(self.conv(x))))
        return x + y if self.res else y


def drop_path(x, p, training):
    if not training or p <= 0.0:
        return x
    keep = 1.0 - p
    mask = x.new_empty(x.shape[0], 1, 1).bernoulli_(keep)
    return x * mask / keep


class EncoderLayer(nn.Module):
    """Pre-norm transformer layer (as nn.TransformerEncoderLayer, norm_first=True) with stochastic depth."""
    def __init__(self, d, n_heads, ff, dropout=0.1, drop_path_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(d, n_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(d, ff)
        self.drop_ff = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(ff, d)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.dp = drop_path_rate

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.norm1(x)
        a = self.attn(h, h, h, need_weights=False)[0]
        x = x + drop_path(self.drop1(a), self.dp, self.training)
        h = self.norm2(x)
        f = self.drop2(self.linear2(self.drop_ff(F.gelu(self.linear1(h)))))
        x = x + drop_path(f, self.dp, self.training)
        return x


class ConvTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, d=192, n_layers=4, n_heads=8, ff=384, attn_dropout=0.1, head_dropout=0.3,
                 drop_path_max=0.2, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            ConvBlock(4, 128, 11, 0.1),
            ConvBlock(128, 128, 7, 0.1),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
            ConvBlock(128, d, 5, 0.1),
            ConvBlock(d, d, 5, 0.1),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
        )
        n_tok = (length // 2) // 2
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, n_tok, d))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        rates = [drop_path_max * i / max(n_layers - 1, 1) for i in range(n_layers)]
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(*[EncoderLayer(d, n_heads, ff, attn_dropout, r) for r in rates])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn_pool = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * d, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(head_dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, n_tasks),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)            # (N, T, d)
        h = self.encoder(h + self.pos)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn_pool(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)   # (N, T, 1)
        pooled = torch.cat([(w * h).sum(1), h.mean(1)], dim=-1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvTransformer()
    net.stem.apply(init_weights)
    net.attn_pool.apply(init_weights)
    net.head.apply(init_weights)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


class BiSelectiveSSM(nn.Module):
    """Bidirectional Mamba-style selective state-space mixer."""
    def __init__(self, d, expand=2, N=8, k=4, dropout=0.1, scan_chunk=256):
        super().__init__()
        E = expand * d
        R = math.ceil(d / 16)
        self.E, self.N, self.R = E, N, R
        self.scan_chunk = scan_chunk
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.in_proj = nn.Linear(d, 2 * E)
        self.conv_f = nn.Conv1d(E, E, k, groups=E, padding=k - 1)
        self.conv_b = nn.Conv1d(E, E, k, groups=E, padding=k - 1)
        self.x_proj_f = nn.Linear(E, R + 2 * N, bias=False)
        self.x_proj_b = nn.Linear(E, R + 2 * N, bias=False)
        self.dt_proj_f = nn.Linear(R, E)
        self.dt_proj_b = nn.Linear(R, E)
        self.A_log = nn.Parameter(torch.log(torch.arange(1, N + 1).float()).repeat(2 * E, 1))
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2 * E))
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(E, d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def _branch(self, x, conv, x_proj, dt_proj):
        L = x.shape[1]
        u = conv(x.transpose(1, 2))[..., :L].transpose(1, 2)
        u = F.silu(u)
        p = x_proj(u)
        dt, Bm, Cm = torch.split(p, [self.R, self.N, self.N], dim=-1)
        dt = F.softplus(dt_proj(dt))
        return u, dt, Bm, Cm

    def _scan(self, u, dt, Bs, Cs, A):
        # u, dt: (b, L, 2, E); Bs, Cs: (b, L, 2, N); A: (2, E, N)
        b, L = u.shape[0], u.shape[1]
        dA = torch.exp(dt[..., None] * A)                       # (b, L, 2, E, N)
        dBu = (dt * u)[..., None] * Bs[:, :, :, None, :]         # (b, L, 2, E, N)
        Cb = Cs[:, :, :, None, :]                                # (b, L, 2, 1, N)
        h = torch.zeros(b, 2, self.E, self.N, device=u.device, dtype=u.dtype)
        ys = []
        for t in range(L):
            h = dA[:, t] * h + dBu[:, t]
            ys.append((h * Cb[:, t]).sum(-1))                   # (b, 2, E)
        return torch.stack(ys, dim=1)                            # (b, L, 2, E)

    def forward(self, x):                       # x: (B, L, d)
        E = self.E
        xz = self.in_proj(self.norm(x))
        xi, z = xz.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        uf, dtf, Bf, Cf = self._branch(xi, self.conv_f, self.x_proj_f, self.dt_proj_f)
        ub, dtb, Bb, Cb = self._branch(xi.flip(1), self.conv_b, self.x_proj_b, self.dt_proj_b)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
            u = torch.stack([uf, ub], dim=2).float()            # (B, L, 2, E)
            dt = torch.stack([dtf, dtb], dim=2).float()
            Bs = torch.stack([Bf, Bb], dim=2).float()           # (B, L, 2, N)
            Cs = torch.stack([Cf, Cb], dim=2).float()
            A = -torch.exp(self.A_log.float()).view(2, E, self.N)
            Bsz = u.shape[0]
            outs = []
            for s in range(0, Bsz, self.scan_chunk):
                e = s + self.scan_chunk
                outs.append(self._scan(u[s:e], dt[s:e], Bs[s:e], Cs[s:e], A))
            y = torch.cat(outs, dim=0)                           # (B, L, 2, E)
            y = y + u * self.D.float().view(2, E)
        yf, yb = y[:, :, 0], y[:, :, 1].flip(1)
        out = (yf + yb).to(z.dtype) * F.silu(z)
        return x + self.drop(self.out_proj(out))


class MambaLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, dropout=0.1, ff_mult=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.mixer = BiSelectiveSSM(d, dropout=dropout)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff_mult * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout), nn.Linear(ff_mult * d, d))
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.mixer(x)
        return x + self.drop(self.ff(self.norm2(x)))


class ConvBiMamba(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, stem=128, d=192, n_layers=4, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, d, 5, padding=2), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 124 -> 62
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([MambaLayer(d, 0.1) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)           # (N, 62, d)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        att = (w * h).sum(dim=1)
        mean = h.mean(dim=1)
        mx = h.max(dim=1).values
        return self.out(self.head(torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvBiMamba()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    for m in net.modules():
        if isinstance(m, BiSelectiveSSM):
            for conv in (m.conv_f, m.conv_b):
                nn.init.normal_(conv.weight, std=0.5 / math.sqrt(conv.kernel_size[0]))
            for dtp in (m.dt_proj_f, m.dt_proj_b):
                nn.init.uniform_(dtp.weight, -m.R ** -0.5, m.R ** -0.5)
                dt = torch.exp(torch.rand(m.E) * (math.log(0.1) - math.log(1e-3)) + math.log(1e-3)).clamp(min=1e-4)
                with torch.no_grad():
                    dtp.bias.copy_(dt + torch.log(-torch.expm1(-dt)))
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.out_proj.weight, gain=0.5)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


def random_shift(x, max_shift):
    """Per-sample random shift in [-max_shift, max_shift] with zero padding."""
    if max_shift <= 0:
        return x
    n, c, L = x.shape
    xp = F.pad(x, (max_shift, max_shift))
    off = torch.randint(0, 2 * max_shift + 1, (n,), device=x.device)
    idx = torch.arange(L, device=x.device)[None, :] + off[:, None]
    idx = idx[:, None, :].expand(n, c, L)
    return xp.gather(2, idx)


class SpatialGatingUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_ffn, n_tok):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_ffn // 2)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(n_tok, n_tok)

    def forward(self, x):                      # x: (N, T, d_ffn)
        u, v = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        v = self.norm(v)
        v = self.proj(v.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
        return u * v


class GMLPBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, d_ffn, n_tok, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(d, d_ffn)
        self.sgu = SpatialGatingUnit(d_ffn, n_tok)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(d_ffn // 2, d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = F.gelu(self.fc1(self.norm(x)))
        y = self.sgu(y)
        y = self.drop(self.fc2(y))
        return x + y


class ConvGMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, stem=128, d=192, d_ffn=768, n_layers=6, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2, max_shift=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.max_shift = max_shift
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, d, 5, padding=2), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 124 -> 62
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        n_tok = (length // 2) // 2
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[GMLPBlock(d, d_ffn, n_tok, 0.1) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.training:
            x = random_shift(x, self.max_shift)
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)           # (N, T, d)
        h = self.blocks(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        att = (w * h).sum(dim=1)
        mean = h.mean(dim=1)
        mx = h.max(dim=1).values
        z = torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.head(z))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvGMLP()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    for m in net.modules():
        if isinstance(m, SpatialGatingUnit):
            nn.init.normal_(m.proj.weight, std=1e-3)
            nn.init.ones_(m.proj.bias)
    return net

A U-Net encoder pools to 15 positions, giving it global context cheaply. The decoder then broadcasts that context back to every 124-resolution motif position through skip concatenation, so each position's features carry both motif identity and sequence-wide context before pooling.

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, k=5, dilation=1, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        pad = dilation * (k - 1) // 2
        self.n1 = bn(d)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(d, d, k, padding=pad, dilation=dilation)
        self.n2 = bn(d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(d, d, k, padding=pad, dilation=dilation)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.c1(F.gelu(self.n1(x)))
        h = self.c2(self.drop(F.gelu(self.n2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c_in, c_out, n_blocks, k, dilations):
        super().__init__()
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool1d(2)
        self.proj = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, 1)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c_out, k, dilations[i % len(dilations)]) for i in range(n_blocks)])

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.blocks(self.proj(self.pool(x)))


class Up(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c_in, c_skip, c_out, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.reduce = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, 1)
        self.norm = bn(c_out + c_skip)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv1d(c_out + c_skip, c_out, 1)
        self.block = ResBlock(c_out, k)

    def forward(self, x, skip):
        x = F.interpolate(x, size=skip.shape[-1], mode="nearest")
        x = self.reduce(x)
        h = torch.cat([x, skip], dim=1)
        h = self.fuse(F.gelu(self.norm(h)))
        return self.block(h)


class UNet1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, chans=(128, 160, 192, 256), out_ch=256, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        c0, c1, c2, c3 = chans
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7), bn(c0), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(c0, c0, 5, padding=2), bn(c0), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                     # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        self.enc0 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c0, 5), ResBlock(c0, 5))          # 124
        self.enc1 = Down(c0, c1, 2, 5, (1,))                                 # 62
        self.enc2 = Down(c1, c2, 2, 3, (1, 2))                               # 31
        self.enc3 = Down(c2, c3, 2, 3, (1, 2))                               # 15 (bottleneck)
        self.up2 = Up(c3, c2, c2, 3)                                         # 31
        self.up1 = Up(c2, c1, c1, 5)                                         # 62
        self.up0 = Up(c1, c0, c0, 5)                                         # 124
        self.post = nn.Sequential(bn(c0), nn.GELU(), nn.Conv1d(c0, out_ch, 1), nn.GELU())
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(out_ch)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(out_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * out_ch, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        h0 = self.enc0(self.stem(x))
        h1 = self.enc1(h0)
        h2 = self.enc2(h1)
        h3 = self.enc3(h2)
        u = self.up2(h3, h2)
        u = self.up1(u, h1)
        u = self.up0(u, h0)
        z = self.post(u).transpose(1, 2)       # (N, L, C)
        z = self.norm(z)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(z).float(), dim=1).to(z.dtype)
        att = (w * z).sum(dim=1)
        mean = z.mean(dim=1)
        mx = z.max(dim=1).values
        return self.out(self.head(torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = UNet1D()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for m in net.modules():
            if isinstance(m, ResBlock):
                m.c2.weight.mul_(0.3)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


def random_shift(x, max_shift):
    """Per-sample random shift in [-max_shift, max_shift] with zero padding."""
    if max_shift <= 0:
        return x
    n, c, L = x.shape
    xp = F.pad(x, (max_shift, max_shift))
    off = torch.randint(0, 2 * max_shift + 1, (n,), device=x.device)
    idx = torch.arange(L, device=x.device)[None, :] + off[:, None]
    idx = idx[:, None, :].expand(n, c, L)
    return xp.gather(2, idx)


class S4DKernel(nn.Module):
    """Diagonal state-space kernel (S4D-Lin init), returns (H, L) real kernel."""
    def __init__(self, H, N=64, dt_min=1e-3, dt_max=1e-1):
        super().__init__()
        log_dt = torch.rand(H) * (math.log(dt_max) - math.log(dt_min)) + math.log(dt_min)
        self.log_dt = nn.Parameter(log_dt)
        self.log_A_real = nn.Parameter(torch.log(0.5 * torch.ones(H, N // 2)))
        self.A_imag = nn.Parameter(math.pi * torch.arange(N // 2).float().repeat(H, 1))
        self.C = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H, N // 2, 2) * (0.5 ** 0.5))

    def forward(self, L):
        dt = torch.exp(self.log_dt.float())
        C = torch.view_as_complex(self.C.float().contiguous())
        A = -torch.exp(self.log_A_real.float()) + 1j * self.A_imag.float()
        dtA = A * dt[:, None]
        pos = torch.arange(L, device=dtA.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        Kexp = torch.exp(dtA[..., None] * pos)          # (H, N/2, L)
        C = C * (torch.exp(dtA) - 1.0) / A
        K = 2 * (C[..., None] * Kexp).sum(dim=1).real   # (H, L)
        return K


class BiS4D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, H, N=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.H = H
        self.kernel = S4DKernel(2 * H, N)
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H))

    @staticmethod
    def fftconv(u, k):
        L = u.shape[-1]
        n = 2 * L
        U = torch.fft.rfft(u, n=n)
        Kf = torch.fft.rfft(k, n=n)
        return torch.fft.irfft(U * Kf, n=n)[..., :L]

    def forward(self, u):  # u: (B, H, L)
        u = u.float()
        L = u.shape[-1]
        k = self.kernel(L)
        kf, kb = k[:self.H], k[self.H:]
        y = self.fftconv(u, kf) + torch.flip(self.fftconv(torch.flip(u, dims=[-1]), kb), dims=[-1])
        return y + u * self.D.float()[None, :, None]


class SpatialGatingUnit(nn.Module):
    """gMLP gate whose token mixing is a bidirectional S4D long convolution."""
    def __init__(self, d_ffn, n_tok, state=64):
        super().__init__()
        h = d_ffn // 2
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(h)
        self.s4 = BiS4D(h, state)
        self.gate_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(h))

    def forward(self, x):                      # x: (N, T, d_ffn)
        u, v = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        v = self.norm(v)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
            g = self.s4(v.float().transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
            g = g + self.gate_bias.float()
        return u * g.to(u.dtype)


class GMLPBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, d_ffn, n_tok, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(d, d_ffn)
        self.sgu = SpatialGatingUnit(d_ffn, n_tok)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(d_ffn // 2, d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = F.gelu(self.fc1(self.norm(x)))
        y = self.sgu(y)
        y = self.drop(self.fc2(y))
        return x + y


class ConvGMLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, stem=128, d=192, d_ffn=768, n_layers=6, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2, max_shift=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.max_shift = max_shift
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, stem, 9, padding=4), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, d, 5, padding=2), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 124 -> 62
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        n_tok = (length // 2) // 2
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[GMLPBlock(d, d_ffn, n_tok, 0.1) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.training:
            x = random_shift(x, self.max_shift)
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)           # (N, T, d)
        h = self.blocks(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        att = (w * h).sum(dim=1)
        mean = h.mean(dim=1)
        mx = h.max(dim=1).values
        z = torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.head(z))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = ConvGMLP()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


def bn2(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm2d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


class PairBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, dilation, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = bn2(c)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=dilation, dilation=dilation)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout2d(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.drop(self.conv(F.gelu(self.norm(x))))


class PairwiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, stem=128, mid=160, dp=64, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 1, 2), dense=256, dropout=0.3,
                 n_tasks=2, length=249):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 15, padding=7), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, stem, 5, padding=2), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, mid, 5, padding=2), bn(mid), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 124 -> 62
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Conv1d(mid, mid, 3, padding=1), bn(mid), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                       # 62 -> 31
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        T = ((length // 2) // 2) // 2
        self.T = T
        self.dp = dp
        self.proj = nn.Conv1d(mid, 4 * dp, 1)
        idx = torch.arange(T)
        self.register_buffer("rel_idx", idx[None, :] - idx[:, None] + (T - 1), persistent=False)
        self.rel = nn.Embedding(2 * T - 1, dp)
        self.pair_norm = bn2(dp)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([PairBlock(dp, d) for d in dilations])
        self.out_norm = bn2(dp)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(dp, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * dp + 2 * mid, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x)                                   # (N, mid, T)
        a, b, u, v = self.proj(h).chunk(4, dim=1)          # each (N, dp, T)
        pe = self.rel(self.rel_idx).permute(2, 0, 1).unsqueeze(0).to(a.dtype)   # (1, dp, T, T)
        pair = a[:, :, :, None] + b[:, :, None, :] + u[:, :, :, None] * v[:, :, None, :] + pe
        pair = self.pair_norm(pair)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            pair = blk(pair)
        z = F.gelu(self.out_norm(pair)).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)   # (N, T*T, dp)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(z).float(), dim=1).to(z.dtype)
        att = (w * z).sum(dim=1)
        mean = z.mean(dim=1)
        mx = z.max(dim=1).values
        h_mean = h.mean(dim=2)
        h_max = h.max(dim=2).values
        feats = torch.cat([att, mean, mx, h_mean, h_max], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.head(feats))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, (nn.Conv1d, nn.Conv2d)):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Embedding):
        nn.init.normal_(m.weight, std=0.1)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = PairwiseNet()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(net.proj.weight)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for blk in net.blocks:
            blk.conv.weight.mul_(0.5)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


class DynamicConv(nn.Module):
    """Lightweight dynamic convolution: each position predicts its own softmax-normalised kernel per head."""
    def __init__(self, d, k, heads=8, weight_dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        assert d % heads == 0 and k % 2 == 1
        self.d, self.k, self.h = d, k, heads
        self.wproj = nn.Linear(d, heads * k)
        self.wdrop = weight_dropout

    def forward(self, x):                      # x: (B, L, d)
        B, L, d = x.shape
        w = self.wproj(x).view(B, L, self.h, self.k)
        w = torch.softmax(w.float(), dim=-1).to(x.dtype)
        w = F.dropout(w, p=self.wdrop, training=self.training)
        xt = x.transpose(1, 2)                 # (B, d, L)
        p = self.k // 2
        xu = F.pad(xt, (p, p)).unfold(2, self.k, 1)          # (B, d, L, k)
        xu = xu.reshape(B, self.h, d // self.h, L, self.k)
        w = w.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).unsqueeze(2)                # (B, h, 1, L, k)
        y = (xu * w).sum(dim=-1).reshape(B, d, L)
        return y.transpose(1, 2)


class DynConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, k, heads=8, dropout=0.1, ff_mult=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.inp = nn.Linear(d, 2 * d)
        self.conv = DynamicConv(d, k, heads)
        self.out = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff_mult * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout), nn.Linear(ff_mult * d, d))

    def forward(self, x):
        z = F.glu(self.inp(self.norm1(x)), dim=-1)
        z = self.out(self.conv(z))
        x = x + self.drop(z)
        x = x + self.drop(self.ff(self.norm2(x)))
        return x


class DynConvNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, stem=128, d=192, kernels=(7, 11, 15, 21, 31, 31), heads=8, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 15, padding=7), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, d, 5, padding=2), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                     # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[DynConvBlock(d, k, heads, 0.1) for k in kernels])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)        # (N, L, d)
        h = self.blocks(h)
        z = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(z).float(), dim=1).to(z.dtype)
        att = (w * z).sum(dim=1)
        mean = z.mean(dim=1)
        mx = z.max(dim=1).values
        return self.out(self.head(torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = DynConvNet()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    for blk in net.blocks:
        nn.init.normal_(blk.conv.wproj.weight, std=0.02)   # start near uniform kernels
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(blk.out.weight, gain=0.5)
    return net

def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, (nn.Conv1d, nn.Linear)):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def random_shift(x, max_shift):
    """Per-sample random shift in [-max_shift, max_shift] with zero padding."""
    if max_shift <= 0:
        return x
    n, c, L = x.shape
    xp = F.pad(x, (max_shift, max_shift))
    off = torch.randint(0, 2 * max_shift + 1, (n,), device=x.device)
    idx = torch.arange(L, device=x.device)[None, :] + off[:, None]
    idx = idx[:, None, :].expand(n, c, L)
    return xp.gather(2, idx)


class S4DKernel(nn.Module):
    """Diagonal state-space kernel (S4D-Lin init), returns (H, L) real kernel."""
    def __init__(self, H, N=64, dt_min=1e-3, dt_max=1e-1):
        super().__init__()
        log_dt = torch.rand(H) * (math.log(dt_max) - math.log(dt_min)) + math.log(dt_min)
        self.log_dt = nn.Parameter(log_dt)
        self.log_A_real = nn.Parameter(torch.log(0.5 * torch.ones(H, N // 2)))
        self.A_imag = nn.Parameter(math.pi * torch.arange(N // 2).float().repeat(H, 1))
        self.C = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H, N // 2, 2) * (0.5 ** 0.5))

    def forward(self, L):
        dt = torch.exp(self.log_dt)
        C = torch.view_as_complex(self.C.contiguous())
        A = -torch.exp(self.log_A_real) + 1j * self.A_imag
        dtA = A * dt[:, None]
        pos = torch.arange(L, device=dtA.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        Kexp = torch.exp(dtA[..., None] * pos)
        C = C * (torch.exp(dtA) - 1.0) / A
        K = 2 * torch.einsum('hn,hnl->hl', C, Kexp).real
        return K


class BiS4D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, H, N=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.H = H
        self.kernel = S4DKernel(2 * H, N)
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(H))

    @staticmethod
    def fftconv(u, k):
        L = u.shape[-1]
        n = 2 * L
        U = torch.fft.rfft(u, n=n)
        Kf = torch.fft.rfft(k, n=n)
        return torch.fft.irfft(U * Kf, n=n)[..., :L]

    def forward(self, u):  # u: (B, H, L)
        u = u.float()
        L = u.shape[-1]
        k = self.kernel(L)
        kf, kb = k[:self.H], k[self.H:]
        y = self.fftconv(u, kf) + torch.flip(self.fftconv(torch.flip(u, dims=[-1]), kb), dims=[-1])
        return y + u * self.D[None, :, None]


class S4Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, H, N=64, dropout=0.1, ff_mult=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(H)
        self.s4 = BiS4D(H, N)
        self.out = nn.Linear(H, 2 * H)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(H)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H, ff_mult * H), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout), nn.Linear(ff_mult * H, H))

    def forward(self, x):  # x: (B, L, H)
        z = self.norm1(x).transpose(1, 2)
        z = self.s4(z).transpose(1, 2)
        z = F.glu(self.out(F.gelu(z)), dim=-1)
        x = x + self.drop(z)
        x = x + self.drop(self.ff(self.norm2(x)))
        return x


class S4DNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model=256, n_layers=6, N=64, dropout=0.1, head_dropout=0.2, n_tasks=2, max_shift=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.max_shift = max_shift
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_model, 15, padding=7),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(d_model),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),
        )
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([S4Block(d_model, N, dropout) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2 * d_model, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(head_dropout), nn.Linear(256, n_tasks)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.training:
            x = random_shift(x, self.max_shift)
        h = self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2)  # (B, 124, H)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean(dim=1), h.max(dim=1).values], dim=-1)
        return self.head(pooled)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = S4DNet()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


def random_shift(x, max_shift):
    """Per-sample random shift in [-max_shift, max_shift] with zero padding."""
    if max_shift <= 0:
        return x
    n, c, L = x.shape
    xp = F.pad(x, (max_shift, max_shift))
    off = torch.randint(0, 2 * max_shift + 1, (n,), device=x.device)
    idx = torch.arange(L, device=x.device)[None, :] + off[:, None]
    idx = idx[:, None, :].expand(n, c, L)
    return xp.gather(2, idx)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, k=5, dilation=1, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        pad = dilation * (k - 1) // 2
        self.n1 = bn(d)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv1d(d, d, k, padding=pad, dilation=dilation)
        self.n2 = bn(d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv1d(d, d, k, padding=pad, dilation=dilation)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.c1(F.gelu(self.n1(x)))
        h = self.c2(self.drop(F.gelu(self.n2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c_in, c_out, n_blocks, k, dilations):
        super().__init__()
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool1d(2)
        self.proj = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, 1)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c_out, k, dilations[i % len(dilations)]) for i in range(n_blocks)])

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.blocks(self.proj(self.pool(x)))


class Up(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c_in, c_skip, c_out, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.reduce = nn.Conv1d(c_in, c_out, 1)
        self.norm = bn(c_out + c_skip)
        self.fuse = nn.Conv1d(c_out + c_skip, c_out, 1)
        self.block = ResBlock(c_out, k)

    def forward(self, x, skip):
        x = F.interpolate(x, size=skip.shape[-1], mode="nearest")
        x = self.reduce(x)
        h = torch.cat([x, skip], dim=1)
        h = self.fuse(F.gelu(self.norm(h)))
        return self.block(h)


class UNet1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, chans=(128, 160, 192, 256), out_ch=256, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2, max_shift=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.max_shift = max_shift
        c0, c1, c2, c3 = chans
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7), bn(c0), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(c0, c0, 5, padding=2), bn(c0), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                     # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        self.enc0 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c0, 5), ResBlock(c0, 5))          # 124
        self.enc1 = Down(c0, c1, 2, 5, (1,))                                 # 62
        self.enc2 = Down(c1, c2, 2, 3, (1, 2))                               # 31
        self.enc3 = Down(c2, c3, 2, 3, (1, 2))                               # 15 (bottleneck)
        self.up2 = Up(c3, c2, c2, 3)                                         # 31
        self.up1 = Up(c2, c1, c1, 5)                                         # 62
        self.up0 = Up(c1, c0, c0, 5)                                         # 124
        self.post = nn.Sequential(bn(c0), nn.GELU(), nn.Conv1d(c0, out_ch, 1), nn.GELU())
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(out_ch)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(out_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * out_ch, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.training:
            x = random_shift(x, self.max_shift)
        h0 = self.enc0(self.stem(x))
        h1 = self.enc1(h0)
        h2 = self.enc2(h1)
        h3 = self.enc3(h2)
        u = self.up2(h3, h2)
        u = self.up1(u, h1)
        u = self.up0(u, h0)
        z = self.post(u).transpose(1, 2)       # (N, L, C)
        z = self.norm(z)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(z).float(), dim=1).to(z.dtype)
        att = (w * z).sum(dim=1)
        mean = z.mean(dim=1)
        mx = z.max(dim=1).values
        return self.out(self.head(torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = UNet1D()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for m in net.modules():
            if isinstance(m, ResBlock):
                m.c2.weight.mul_(0.3)
    return net

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


def random_shift(x, max_shift):
    """Per-sample random shift in [-max_shift, max_shift] with zero padding."""
    if max_shift <= 0:
        return x
    n, c, L = x.shape
    xp = F.pad(x, (max_shift, max_shift))
    off = torch.randint(0, 2 * max_shift + 1, (n,), device=x.device)
    idx = torch.arange(L, device=x.device)[None, :] + off[:, None]
    idx = idx[:, None, :].expand(n, c, L)
    return xp.gather(2, idx)


class SpatialGate(nn.Module):
    """gMLP-style spatial gating term: LayerNorm over channels, then a learned projection across positions."""
    def __init__(self, d, n_tok):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(n_tok, n_tok)

    def forward(self, b):                       # b: (N, d, L)
        v = self.norm(b.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)   # (N, d, L)
        return self.proj(v)                     # mixes positions


class GatedBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, skip, dilation, n_tok, k=3, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = bn(d)
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(d, 2 * d, k, padding=dilation * (k - 1) // 2, dilation=dilation)
        self.sgu = SpatialGate(d, n_tok)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.res = nn.Conv1d(d, d, 1)
        self.skip = nn.Conv1d(d, skip, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv(self.norm(x))
        a, b = h.chunk(2, dim=1)
        b = b + self.sgu(b)
        g = torch.tanh(a) * torch.sigmoid(b)
        g = self.drop(g)
        return x + self.res(g), self.skip(g)


class GatedDilatedNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, d=128, skip=128, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), cycles=2, out_ch=256, dense=256,
                 dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2, max_shift=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.max_shift = max_shift
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d, 15, padding=7), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(d, d, 5, padding=2), bn(d), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                     # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        n_tok = length // 2
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([GatedBlock(d, skip, dil, n_tok) for _ in range(cycles) for dil in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.GELU(), nn.Conv1d(skip, out_ch, 1), nn.GELU())
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(out_ch)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(out_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * out_ch, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(len(self.blocks))

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.training:
            x = random_shift(x, self.max_shift)
        h = self.stem(x)
        s = 0
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h, sk = blk(h)
            s = s + sk
        z = self.post(s * self.scale).transpose(1, 2)   # (N, L, C)
        z = self.norm(z)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(z).float(), dim=1).to(z.dtype)
        att = (w * z).sum(dim=1)
        mean = z.mean(dim=1)
        mx = z.max(dim=1).values
        return self.out(self.head(torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = GatedDilatedNet()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    for blk in net.blocks:
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(blk.conv.weight)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(blk.res.weight, gain=0.5)
        nn.init.normal_(blk.sgu.proj.weight, std=1e-3)
        nn.init.zeros_(blk.sgu.proj.bias)
    return net

models.hypothesis: A global, data-gated long convolution whose implicit filters span every position, with multi-scale exponential windows that also give it local filters, captures both motif grammar and distal interactions. With the ±3 bp shift it should join the top cluster, as S4D and gMLP do.
models.predicted_effect: Best validation score about 1.17 to 1.18 (within one floor of S4D C28, about 0.7 floors behind C46). Best epoch in the second half of the onecycle anneal. Speed about 40 to 60 s/epoch.
models.change_summary: New backbone: C46's stem (to 124 positions, 128 ch) then a linear projection to d=192, 6 pre-LN Hyena blocks and an FFN x2, and C46's attention+mean+max pooled head. Each Hyena block has: in_proj to 3d; a short depthwise conv k3; y = x2 * (longconv(x1*v, h) + D*(x1*v)) with h = sin-MLP(positional features over 247 offsets) times a per-channel exponential decay window, L1-normalised with a learned gain; the FFT runs in fp32. train_params kept from C46.

def bn(channels):
    return nn.BatchNorm1d(channels, eps=1e-3, momentum=0.01)


def random_shift(x, max_shift):
    """Per-sample random shift in [-max_shift, max_shift] with zero padding."""
    if max_shift <= 0:
        return x
    n, c, L = x.shape
    xp = F.pad(x, (max_shift, max_shift))
    off = torch.randint(0, 2 * max_shift + 1, (n,), device=x.device)
    idx = torch.arange(L, device=x.device)[None, :] + off[:, None]
    idx = idx[:, None, :].expand(n, c, L)
    return xp.gather(2, idx)


class Sin(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim, w=10.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.freq = nn.Parameter(w * torch.ones(1, dim))

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sin(self.freq * x)


class ImplicitFilter(nn.Module):
    """Non-causal implicit filter over offsets -(L-1)..(L-1): sin-MLP of positional features times decay windows."""
    def __init__(self, d, L, emb=17, hidden=64, decay_min=0.3, decay_max=30.0):
        super().__init__()
        K = 2 * L - 1
        t = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, K)[:, None]                  # (K, 1)
        bands = (emb - 1) // 2
        f = torch.linspace(1e-4, bands - 1, bands)[None, :]          # (1, bands)
        z = torch.cat([t, torch.cos(math.pi * f * t), torch.sin(math.pi * f * t)], dim=-1)  # (K, emb)
        self.register_buffer("z", z)
        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(emb, hidden), Sin(hidden),
            nn.Linear(hidden, hidden), Sin(hidden),
            nn.Linear(hidden, d),
        )
        rates = torch.exp(torch.linspace(math.log(decay_min), math.log(decay_max), d))
        window = torch.exp(-rates[:, None] * t.abs().T)                # (d, K)
        self.register_buffer("window", window)
        self.gain = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(d, 1))

    def forward(self):
        h = self.mlp(self.z.float()).T * self.window                  # (d, K)
        h = h / (h.abs().sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        return h * self.gain


class HyenaOperator(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, L):
        super().__init__()
        self.L = L
        self.in_proj = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.short = nn.Conv1d(3 * d, 3 * d, 3, padding=1, groups=3 * d)
        self.filt = ImplicitFilter(d, L)
        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(d))
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        n = 1
        while n < 3 * L - 2:
            n *= 2
        self.nfft = n

    def forward(self, x):                                  # x: (N, L, d)
        L = self.L
        z = self.short(self.in_proj(x).transpose(1, 2))    # (N, 3d, L)
        x1, x2, v = z.chunk(3, dim=1)
        u = x1 * v
        with torch.autocast(device_type=u.device.type, enabled=False):
            uf = u.float()
            h = self.filt()                                # (d, 2L-1)
            n = self.nfft
            y = torch.fft.irfft(torch.fft.rfft(uf, n=n) * torch.fft.rfft(h, n=n), n=n)[..., L - 1:2 * L - 1]
            y = y + uf * self.D.float()[:, None]
        y = y.to(x2.dtype) * x2
        return self.out_proj(y.transpose(1, 2))


class HyenaBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, L, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.op = HyenaOperator(d, L)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(d, 2 * d)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(2 * d, d)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.drop(self.op(self.norm1(x)))
        y = self.fc2(self.drop(F.gelu(self.fc1(self.norm2(x)))))
        return x + self.drop(y)


class HyenaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, length=249, stem=128, d=192, n_layers=6, dense=256, dropout=0.3, n_tasks=2, max_shift=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.max_shift = max_shift
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, stem, 15, padding=7), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(stem, stem, 5, padding=2), bn(stem), nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(2),                     # 249 -> 124
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
        )
        L = length // 2
        self.proj = nn.Linear(stem, d)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[HyenaBlock(d, L, 0.1) for _ in range(n_layers)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(d, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(dense, dense), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.out = nn.Linear(dense, n_tasks)

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.training:
            x = random_shift(x, self.max_shift)
        h = self.proj(self.stem(x).transpose(1, 2))      # (N, L, d)
        h = self.blocks(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        w = torch.softmax(self.attn(h).float(), dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        att = (w * h).sum(dim=1)
        mean = h.mean(dim=1)
        mx = h.max(dim=1).values
        return self.out(self.head(torch.cat([att, mean, mx], dim=1)))


def init_weights(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Conv1d):
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, nonlinearity="relu")
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    elif isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)


def build_model():
    """Returns the network: (N, 4, 249) one-hot -> (N, 2) = [Dev, Hk]."""
    net = HyenaNet()
    net.apply(init_weights)
    for blk in net.blocks:
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(blk.op.out_proj.weight, gain=0.5)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(blk.fc2.weight, gain=0.5)
        nn.init.normal_(blk.op.short.weight, std=0.3)
    return net

models.predicted_effect: Best validation about 0.01-0.015 below C43 (about 1.148-1.152), with the best epoch late in the anneal as before and slightly slower epochs (about +10-15 s).
